$Comment: What clearing the Yeti Cave pays each player there at the end, beside the Yeti's own Claims: the
dungeon's Rewards (Dungeons/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json) roll it into the chest where the Yeti fell, full
the first clear each day and half on later ones: every quantity halves, a leftover half paying by
chance. Every roll here always pays: Christmas Coins and festival tokens through the Currency reward
kind, Ice Essence (Count to CountMax an even pick), two Christmas Presents the Yeti had stashed, and
favor on Santa's Nice List through the Reputation reward kind. Mmo_Christmas_Yeti_Cave_Clear.json adds
Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. A companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in
Name: Christmas_Yeti_Cave_Clear
